name: Tounges
overview: Scripture reveals that speaking in tongues is a manifestation of the Holy Spirit's work, as seen on the day of Pentecost when believers were filled with the Spirit and spoke with other tongues as He enabled them. This spiritual gift serves to edify the believer and is connected to prayer, with the Spirit interceding on our behalf through inexpressible groanings when we do not know how to pray as we ought.
